criteria.false: Any part of the claim is missing from, contradicted by, or stronger than the evidence
criteria.true: Every part of the claim is directly backed by the evidence

supported.instructions: Does the `evidence` in state fully support the `claim` in state, with no part of the claim going beyond the evidence?

state.claim: On the 50-document FUNSD test split, scored by one frozen protocol (pre-registered before any run): the vision-LLM arm (Gemini 3 Flash Preview through the connected route) beat the classical arm (Tesseract 5.3.4 plus deterministic layout rules) on micro field-level F1 by 0.4029 to 0.0645, a margin of 0.3384 against a pre-registered confirmation line of 0.15 (H1 CONFIRMED). The classical arm's micro OCR word error rate was 0.6942, above the pre-registered 0.10 line (H2 CONFIRMED). The latency hypothesis is INCONCLUSIVE: median per-document time was 3.58 s for the classical arm and 7.46 s for the vision arm, which is neither the 5x classical advantage the protocol required for confirmation nor a classical loss. The vision arm's numbers are coverage-limited: 29 of its 50 documents failed and scored zero predicted pairs under the frozen failure rule, 27 of them with HTTP 429 rate-limit rejections from the access route and 2 with call timeouts; on the 21 documents the route answered, the vision arm's descriptive F1 was 0.7687 against the classical arm's 0.0628 on the same documents.
state.evidence: Generated results file (script output of scripts/make_results.py over results/arm_a.jsonl and results/arm_b.jsonl; not hand-typed): Arm A precision 0.0941, recall 0.0490, F1 0.0645, true positives 40 of 425 predicted pairs against 816 ground-truth pairs; Arm B precision 0.7865, recall 0.2708, F1 0.4029, true positives 221 of 281 predicted against the same 816. Arm A WER 0.6942 from 6060 token edits over 8729 reference tokens. Median seconds per document: Arm A 3.58 (mean 4.10, IQR 3.47); Arm B 7.46 (mean 34.84, IQR 15.35). Arm B made 89 API calls for 50 documents; 29 documents are recorded failed in the raw JSONL, with error strings: 27 records 'HTTPError: HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests' and 2 records 'TimeoutError: call exceeded 180 s deadline'. Answered-subset descriptor computed from the same raw records: 21 answered documents hold 294 ground-truth pairs; Arm B true positives 221 of 281 predicted (F1 0.7687); Arm A on the same 21 documents scored 14 true positives of 152 predicted (F1 0.0628). Protocol: PREREGISTRATION.md is the first commit of the repository; pass lines H1 margin 0.15, H2 WER 0.10, H3 five-times median advantage; verdicts computed by scripts/make_results.py, not typed by hand.
